_comment: Hand-curated dataset records. The registry builder adds existence checks, sequence counts and manifest hashes. Datasets are never copied or moved by the workspace tools. Two splits are treated as the same only if listed in 'verified_identical'.

datasets.name: Anti-UAV (2021, Jiang et al.) — 318 IR/RGB sequence pairs
datasets.label_format: per sequence infrared.json / visible.json: exist[], gt_rect[] = [x, y, w, h] px
limitations: VAL shares all 26 recording sessions with TRAIN (TEST shares none): VAL is optimistic
released box count ~2 % below the paper's Table I
datasets.test_split_status: TEST exposed by the Direction B registered passes and by CF; locked for selection

datasets.name: CST Anti-UAV (complete release) — thermal IR tiny UAVs
datasets.provenance: official release, 11 archive parts; complete copy since 2026-10-05 (experiments/cst_completion)
datasets.label_format: per sequence IR_label.json: exist[], gt_rect[] = [x, y, w, h] px; SIZE / attribute codes
limitations: VAL shares source videos with TRAIN (paper section 3.3): VAL gains are optimistic
datasets.test_split_status: TEST exposed by X1, X2 and CF registered passes; locked

datasets.name: CST Anti-UAV truncated copy (corpus v1; parts z01-z07 only)
limitations: 84/120 train sequences, no official val; never use for new work

datasets.name: Det-Fly (Roboflow export, drone + bird)
datasets.test_split_status: used once in detector TEST passes

datasets.name: AeroTrack unified YOLO corpus v2 (Anti-UAV + complete CST + Det-Fly)
limitations: derived; CST/Det-Fly images are junctions into data/

datasets.name: AeroTrack unified YOLO corpus v1 (truncated CST)
Track C trajectories (GT tracks of Anti-UAV IR/RGB + CST)
datasets.label_format: npz: vis[T], box[T,4] xywh px (NaN when absent) + JSON sequence index
